author: Mary Gilleece
description:

author: Chris Morrison
description:
Up to 20% of oil and gas is turned into petrochemicals for life-saving uses like medicines and fertiliser. With no serious substitutes on the horizon, Net Zero is looking more disastrous by the day, says Chris Morrison.

The post Net Zero Lunatics Set to Empty Your Medicine Cabinet appeared first on The Daily Sceptic.
title: Net Zero Lunatics Set to Empty Your Medicine Cabinet
